mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, prompting the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPI YoY > 2% and FEDFUNDS subsequently increase.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of instances where HOUST increases significantly.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which is associated with increased corporate earnings and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE falls below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, which is a positive indicator for corporate earnings and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a weakening consumer demand, which is a negative indicator for corporate earnings and thus negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS decreases by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs month-over-month signals a strong labor market, which is associated with increased economic activity and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 jobs MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals a slowing economy, which is a negative indicator for corporate earnings and thus negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 decreases by more than 0.5% QoQ.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a strong demand across both sectors, which is a positive indicator for broad economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase by more than 1% MoM.
